summary: ADVO presented a roughly 70%-complete prototype of a fun-run registration website to the Fun Ride PH / MyriadSports organizers, whose main complaint about their current process is too many steps from registration to payment. The prototype has Choose Your Distance, Race Information, Schedule and FAQ sections, a six-step registration flow, a results page with podium and social sharing, and an organizer portal with income reports. The client's kick-off event is November 7 and they want the registration site live by end of July, with ADVO estimating about two weeks of development once the client sends assets within the following week. The payment gateway is not finalized (credit cards and BDO were mentioned and the client will handle the BDO application), sponsor discount codes will be supported, and tickets and pickup will use QR codes, though offline scanning at pickup was raised as a concern with an Excel/Google Sheets export as the fallback. ADVO also demoed a gamified territory-claiming fitness app prototype, and the client suggested buying the MyriadSports.com.ph domain.

fact.claim: The client's primary requirement is fewer steps between registration, category selection and payment, because the current process has too many steps.
fact.quote: I don't want to have too many things from the point of registration to payment to choosing my category where I am. Because that's what we're having a problem with right now. There's a lot of process and I think that's what concerns the participants.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The prototype is a full-page themed site with Choose Your Distance, Race Information, Schedule and FAQs sections and a six-step registration.
fact.quote: It's full page. It's themed to the design of the image provided by the organizers. Here is Choose Your Distance, Race Information, Schedule, FAQs. Then you can also register. And there's a six-step registration where you'll pick your ticket.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client's vision is multiple events across the year, with November 7 as the kick-off event.
fact.quote: So our vision for the fun fair that we have right now is for it to be multiple events happening like schedules here for the rest of the year. ... But basically, what we're doing right now for November 7 is to kick off first.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client asked for a walkthrough video covering registration through payment.
fact.quote: Can we make a walkthrough video for this type of registration, from registration to your payment.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The payment gateway is not yet decided; the prototype's payment step is test data and not live.
fact.quote: The payment mode is not sure yet. This is just test data. It's not live yet.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Payment options will include credit cards; BDO availability is to be finalized later.
fact.quote: Of course. Maybe there's no BDO branch there. We'll finalize it later on. There are also credit cards. If you want to use it for that one
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The client (Speaker 1) will manage the BDO application on their side.
fact.quote: I'll be managing BDO's application here!
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client wants ID verification built into registration so eligible people can get a special rate or free enrollment.
fact.quote: We were looking for their ID so that they can avail of a special rate or even a free enrollment, but apparently they don't have that technology. You can incorporate that with the registration.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Sponsors can be given a specific discount code (e.g. 5% for their members) implemented according to the terms the sponsor provides.
fact.quote: For sponsors, they provide a code. Let's say if some of their employees want to join the run or the ride, we can put a specific code for them. ... if in Viber, they want 5% for their runners or your members, we can incorporate that based on the terms they provide to you guys
fact.speaker: Speaker 6

fact.claim: The results page has a podium and race card, supports search by name or number, filtering, and sharing to social media.
fact.quote: So this was the result page, the finished runs. Where you can see the result. We added here the podium, and the race card.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: A mobile version of the site was requested because most users are on mobile.
fact.quote: Can you make a mobile version? Of course.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: ADVO stated the client gets 100% ownership of the website and ADVO can offer maintenance separately.
fact.quote: You'll have one hundred percent rights, one hundred percent ownership of the website. And for what do you call this? Yung kapag may maintenance we can ayun po we can offer maintenance also for that.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The client wants exclusivity: the site's special features must not be given to other websites in the future.
fact.quote: So for now, we will also have the disclosure, like whatever perks or the special feature of the website. We won't give it to other websites in the future if we're going to expand. It's only for us.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The prototype shown is about 70% of the website and the design can still change.
fact.quote: So if you have any concerns on the design, we can still change it since it's a prototype. This is around 70% of what we can show you in terms of the website.
fact.speaker: Speaker 5

fact.claim: The client's goal is to have the registration site up by the end of July 2026.
fact.quote: Our goal is really to put this up by the end of the month. We're going to have registration and eventually, because it will go hand in hand when we get sponsors for this.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Organizers on the platform can choose between a basic modular design and a custom design per event.
fact.quote: Actually right now, yung modular na design is a choice. Diba may mga organizers, they put their events. They have the option to choose whether they want it, basic modular lang or custom design.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The logo must be animated, and shirt/kit assets should zoom in on cursor hover.
fact.quote: For now, definitely the logo must be animated. ... Next time for the assets for the shirts. When you click on the mouse cursor, it will zoom in on a particular point.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Registration should take at most two to three minutes to complete.
fact.quote: At least two to three minutes max, para naman mahatid pa rin. Better efficiency of registration
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: A Polnavo V3 RS bike is a confirmed raffle prize to be highlighted on the page; the target audience is gamers.
fact.quote: One thing that's confirmed is we'll be giving out one. Polnavo V3 RS bike na pre-announced part of the raffle. ... I want to highlight that within the page because we're targeting gamers. Our audience are gamers.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The landing page is the client's top priority and should be grounded and friendly, not so high-end that it alienates users.
fact.quote: But basically, the landing page is the most important to me. ... There's a thin line between making it usual and making it too high-end ... So somehow, make it grounded but friendly.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer portal has a dashboard with event reports including income.
fact.quote: This is for the organizer portal. So this is the dashboard events report. I can see how the report, like the income etcetera.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The client wants failed registrations and payment errors (e.g. connection drops) reflected in the portal, and ADVO agreed to incorporate it.
fact.quote: Also, for the failed aspects of registration, if you click it and it didn't work or you have a problem with connection and it didn't process your payment, will that be reflected as well?
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: After registration, tickets and event-day pickup will be handled with a QR code.
fact.quote: What we're about what we're gonna do there in terms of after registration is for tickets and pickup on the day of the event, they'll just be a QR code.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The pickup partner (Kuya Rey) cannot scan QR codes without internet, which is a risk for on-site claiming.
fact.quote: Kuya Rey sa pickup nila. So may QR code ano tayo scanner. Wala yung QR pag walang internet kasi yun yung nagbibigay ng battery net.
fact.speaker: Speaker 4

fact.claim: The organizer side will have an export of all participant data (ticket number and details) to Google Sheets or Excel.
fact.quote: Maybe on the website for sure, on organizers because they'll have an export to Google Sheets or Excel.
fact.speaker: Speaker 7

fact.claim: ADVO estimates about two weeks of development, with the first week for the initial build.
fact.quote: About two weeks can meet the set timeline.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Hosting is on Cloudflare and server size can be increased to handle traffic.
fact.quote: I don't have the specific number pero depende yun sa hosting site kasi. Yung Cloudflare, they have a big, big server and storage and memory for that.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Sponsors will be shown with animated logos on the landing page.
fact.quote: But we'll put the sponsor with animated logo at the landing page throughout next month only.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client will send the website assets to ADVO within the following week (target Friday).
fact.quote: So far yun lang naman and then probably within next week. Within next week, we'll be sending the assets to you. So you can lay out the page and then from there we'll see.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The client proposed acquiring the domain MyriadSports.com.ph.
fact.quote: Kasi kung lalaki siya I think we should get that domain MyriadSports dot com dot PH. Wow, gano kahirap dyan?
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: ADVO demoed a gamified fitness app prototype where riding or jogging a road claims it as your territory, with routes at Academic Oval, BGC and Makati.
fact.quote: The model is like a bike. As you move through, the game is about getting territory. When you ride on that road, your location will be blue. So it's like your territory that you claim.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The app is planned to integrate with the registration website's events in the future.
fact.quote: And then we've also talked about future proofing it. So let's say, in the future, you want to connect this with the website for registration.
fact.speaker: Speaker 6

fact.claim: Assets are expected by July 25, 2026.
fact.quote: Assets are expected by July 25, 2026.

decision.text: Sponsor-specific discount codes will be built into registration, applied per the terms each sponsor gives the organizer.
The website will be delivered with 100% ownership to the client; maintenance is a separate offer from ADVO.
The logo will be animated and the site must have both mobile and desktop versions.
Tickets and event-day pickup will use QR codes, with an Excel/Google Sheets export of participants as the organizer-side fallback.
Failed registration and payment-error tracking will be incorporated into the organizer portal.
Payment gateway provider and the full payment method list (BDO, credit cards) are NOT decided yet.

action.description: Meet with the creative team and graphic artists to finalize website visual assets, then send assets to ADVO
Manage the BDO merchant application on the client side
Implement sponsor discount codes (e.g. 5% for a sponsor's members) per sponsor terms
Add failed-registration / payment-error tracking and email prompt to the organizer portal
Build a mobile version of the registration site
Add animated sponsor logos and hover-zoom on shirt/bib/medal assets on the landing page
Finalize the payment gateway and payment method list (BDO, credit cards)
Check availability and cost of the MyriadSports.com.ph domain
Send proposals to the client after the meeting

openQuestion.text: Which payment gateway will be used, and will BDO and credit cards both be available?
How will QR tickets be claimed at pickup when the pickup partner has no internet or QR reader?
Will fulfillment offer both pickup and courier delivery, and who carries the courier charge?
Is the gamified app part of this engagement or a separate initiative, and what is its timeline and budget?
What does the MyriadSports.com.ph domain cost (the transcript mentions 'thousand dollars')?
How many concurrent users can the hosting handle? (no specific number given)
